test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On account of corona virus, 5% of the population of a village died. Out of the remaining population, 20% fled due to panic. If the present population is 4655, then what was the population of the village before the corona attack?
solution:
**Given:**

Present population = 4655

5% of the population died due to corona virus.

20% of the remaining population fled due to panic.

**Formula Used:**

Let the initial population be P .

Population after 5% died = P - 0.05P = 0.95P

Population after 20% fled = 0.95P - 0.20(0.95P)

Present population = 4655

**Calculation:**

Population after 20% fled = 0.95P - 0.20(0.95P)

⇒ Population after 20% fled = 0.95P(1 - 0.20)

⇒ Population after 20% fled = 0.95P × 0.80

⇒ Population after 20% fled = 0.76P

Given that this equals the present population:

⇒ 0.76P = 4
655

⇒ P = (4655)/(0.76)

⇒ P = 6125

**The population of the village before the corona attack was 6125.**
